prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with high carbohydrate intake for endurance performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 meals/snacks distributed throughout the day with carbohydrate-focused meals timed around training
Daily caloric and macronutrient targets appropriate for a 68kg endurance athlete in training (approximately 2800-3200 calories with 55-65% carbohydrates)
All meals comply with vegetarian and nut-free restrictions
Plan is presented in compact, single-day format with clear meal timing
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring elevated carbohydrate and calorie intake with specific timing around training sessions
